mapper.select: SELECT id, template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, preview_uri AS previewUri, is_subaccount_visible AS isSubaccountVisible, CAST(supported_params AS CHAR) AS supportedParamsJson, remark, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM promotion_landing_template WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
